name: tracker-managed-host-launch
goal: Prove the configured native and Docker launcher, nine-slot host admission, retained observed pane and legacy exit adoption using isolated processes.

evidence: Initial draft required an unbound external runner, applied a fixed two-slot cap, discarded the idle planner's observed-run closure, and could not observe a retained run after pane disappearance. The parent confirmed the migrated eight-plus-one and observed-pane cases and authorized synthetic proof only.

Use the foreground, provider process, retained-packet and pane method states to cover owned worktree startup, repeated attempt adoption, the nine-slot configured limit, due disk scoping, and exact legacy exit sentinel handling. Freeze all tests and fixtures for the paired record.
